style.register: 游戏指南体，简体中文，简洁直陈，不用敬语，不用『您』。

style.properNouns: 国家、人物、舰名等专有名词使用通用中文译名（如 German Reich → 德意志国，Adolf Hitler → 阿道夫·希特勒）；Paradox 未汉化的专有名词可保留英文并加中文注释。
style.consistency: 同一英文术语在全站必须使用同一译名。

Representing a united Indonesian nation (specifically the past Austronesian entities of Srivijaya and Majapahit Empires which reached its peak in the 13th century), the ⟦0⟧ can be formed by ⟦1⟧ and requires the nation to be fully independent and united under one banner with the ⟦2⟧ in order to be formed. Without the ⟦3⟧ DLC enabled, it is also possible for the Dutch East Indies to create this formable.

The idea of an archipelago-spanning nation with a shared civic identity (instead of ethnic or religious ones) was first promulgated by Ernest Douwes Dekker, an early Indies nationalist, in the 1910s; specifically using Nusantara as the name of the future nation and using the previous Srivijaya and Majapahit Empires as basis of the idea. Tan Malaka, a renowned Indonesian Marxist, would later added Malaya, North Borneo, East Papua, East Timor, and the ⟦0⟧ on his own United Indonesia idea in 1926, propagating that all the colonies' indigenous populaces are Indonesians by blood, divided only by the colonial powers.

Greater Mongolia can be formed by ⟦0⟧, ⟦1⟧ and the ⟦2⟧ after it was released by ⟦3⟧ via the focus ⟦4⟧. The formable represents a revival of the older, much bigger Mongolian state under Genghis Khan and his hordes.
Federation of Malayan Peoples/Association of South East Asian Nations

The ⟦0⟧ can be formed in two ways, by two countries: The ⟦1⟧ can create this formable via proposing Maphillindo in the ⟦2⟧ decisions after approving the Soetardjo Petition, beginning negotiations with Soetardjo, becoming a democratic Indonesia and finally, following the ratification of the 1936 Soetardjo Act, building the independent Republic of Indonesia. The ⟦3⟧ on the other hand simply need to annex Indonesia and ⟦4⟧ in order to unite the Malayan Peoples with the decision ⟦5⟧.

The ⟦0⟧ can - in contrast to the ⟦1⟧ - only be created by the ⟦2⟧. In order to do that, the country needs to first form Maphillindo via annexing the ⟦3⟧ as well as ⟦4⟧ and then integrate either Siam, Indochina or Burma.
Union of South East Asian Nations

⟦0⟧ can be formed by either one of the Indian princely states, ⟦1⟧ or ⟦2⟧ and represents the broader unification of the Indian subcontinent, since the Persian name Hindustan is the one historically used for the entire region.

⟦0⟧ is a formable nation and it represents the first civilization in history. It encompasses the lands in and around the Nile, Tigris, and Euphrates rivers. It is a decision available at the start of the game for (when released) ⟦1⟧, ⟦2⟧, ⟦3⟧ and ⟦4⟧. ⟦5⟧ can create this formable after forming ⟦6⟧.
Upon formation, the country that formed Mesopotamia will change colors and flag.
Union of Assyrian Soviet Socialist Republics

Neo-Assyrian Empire is a formable nation representing one of the ancient empires that collapsed many centuries ago. However, assyrians still exist to this day and you can reclaim their glory via a decision. This is a formable exclusive to the nation of ⟦0⟧.

The ⟦0⟧ is a formable nation that represents the Turkish nation that was formed in 1299 and dominated the Middle East and Arabia between the 14th and 20th centuries in which it was most commonly known as the ⟦1⟧. It entered into a period of stagnation and decline from the mid-1700s onwards and finally collapsed because of their involvement in the First World War in 1918, being officially dissolved in 1922-1923 with ⟦2⟧ being the successor state.
In the ⟦0⟧ DLC, ⟦1⟧ gets its own focus tree which allows ⟦2⟧ to form the ⟦3⟧ with the focus ⟦4⟧. Doing so will also move the capital to Istanbul and rename it to Konstantiniyye.

To form ⟦2⟧, the player first needs to complete the focus ⟦3⟧ and the event 'The Future of Afghanistan' pops up, which allows you to choose which identity you want for ⟦4⟧. Choosing the option of "We are a nation of the Pashtuns above all else" will allow you to form ⟦5⟧ and get cores on parts of ⟦6⟧.

The second option is by going down the path of ⟦0⟧ and you will get three paths for crowning an Emir. If you ⟦1⟧, it will eventually let you do the focus of ⟦2⟧. This allows you to form ⟦3⟧ and be able to Proclaim a New Caliphate where you can core any Muslim states.

The Savior of The Holy Lands

The ⟦0⟧ can either be formed by the ⟦1⟧ via the focus ⟦2⟧ or by one of the Chinese warlords after cooperating with the Communists, becoming the new Chinese Soviet Republic (following the Yan'an Incident) and then proclaim the People's Republic.

Persia, not to be confused with the non-aligned name for ⟦0⟧, is a formable nation that involves a secret path in Iran's focus tree. It represents a time before the Pahlavi Dynasty overthrew the previous Qajar Dynasty in 1929. This marked a change for the nation of ⟦1⟧ as it sought to industrialize and catch up to the world, as a result it abandoned the name ⟦2⟧ as the shah changed it in 1935 to align with a native name rather than the foreign one used on them for centuries. In order to take a trip to the past and restore the old name, you will have to unlock the sub-branch that automatically completes the focus ⟦3⟧. This requires you to be in a defensive war against another nation as historically, both the British and the Soviets organized a joint invasion on ⟦4⟧. In this case, we will need the ⟦5⟧ to declare war on ⟦6⟧ and make your way down to the focus ⟦7⟧. This gives an event to the nation you are at war with and makes you submit to them, becoming a puppet if they agree. If they accept you will unlock the focus ⟦8⟧ if you submitted to the ⟦9⟧. This gives you access to the democratic branch of your focus tree if you chose another path from that. However, if you submitted to the ⟦10⟧, you will unlock the focus ⟦11⟧ which gives you access to the communist branch if you were in another path. Sticking to being a British puppet, finish the focus ⟦12⟧ and a new hidden focus will appear named ⟦13⟧. This gives you an event called "The return of the Qajar Dynasty" and choosing "Why wait? Prepare the Coronation" will form ⟦14⟧. This will consequently make Reza Pahlavi and his son get exiled to ⟦15⟧, making him a general and a political advisor.
Declare Loyalty to the United Kingdom

It is only available without the ⟦1⟧ DLC.

Formable by ⟦0⟧, the ⟦1⟧ represents a restoration of the territory controlled by Siam from 1782 until the 1932 revolution where the absolute monarchy was abandoned in favor of a constitutional monarchy. It is only available without the ⟦2⟧ DLC.

Should the ⟦0⟧ be dismantled for whatever reason, then ⟦1⟧ or one of the releasable successor states in Siberia can decide to pick up the pieces of the fallen union and save what still can be saved by forming a united ⟦2⟧ to prevent the lands east of the Ural Mountains from falling under foreign influence. In order to form Siberia, a large portion of the ⟦3⟧ east of the Ural Mountains must be controlled. After forming Siberia, it is possible to expand Siberia to include the territory of the ⟦4⟧, westward to the Ural Mountains, and the areas inhabited by the Ainu people of the northern islands of ⟦5⟧.

The Timurid Empire was a mighty empire that collapsed centuries ago. However, it can be restored either by ⟦0⟧ or ⟦1⟧.

⟦0⟧ can form it by going down the path of ⟦1⟧ in order to start the Mughal uprising with the Princely States. The focus ⟦2⟧ will start the uprising letting you be The ⟦3⟧. You will have limited time for capturing as much land from the ⟦4⟧ as possible before the British intervenes with a ceasefire.

⟦0⟧ can form it by going down the path of going down the path of ⟦1⟧ and you will get three paths for crowning an Emir after you finish the civil war. Finishing the focus ⟦2⟧ will make ⟦3⟧ be known as The ⟦4⟧. Making your way down to the focus ⟦5⟧ will let you form The ⟦6⟧.

Representing a unification of sorts between peoples hailing from the regions of Inner and Central Asia, ⟦0⟧ (or the ⟦1⟧) is a formable nation. Turanism is an outgrowth of both pan-Turkism and the Altaic Hypothesis, which posits that Eurasian nations of the Turkic, Mongolic, Siberian, Manchu, Korean, and even Finno-Ugric and Japanese peoples share a common "Altaic" origin (named after the Altai mountains). The Altaic Hypothesis is no longer widely accepted by scholars but continues to retain the support of a few dedicated linguists and anthropologists. Turan can, among other things, "unite" with ⟦2⟧, ⟦3⟧, ⟦4⟧, ⟦5⟧, and ⟦6⟧.

In fact, the formation of ⟦0⟧ requires ⟦1⟧ to more or less take on the role of a rogue state trying to serve its own interests against the wills of the major powers, which likely means causing quite a bit of ruckus both diplomatically and militarily (and most likely tearing off a large chunk of ⟦2⟧ and ripping apart most of the ⟦3⟧ in the process).
